_comment: Rides and water activities acted out in 3D (components/interior/rides). kind = how it plays; track = which piece of the venue it uses (see rides/tracks.ts). realHeight (m) scales the speed shown to the real ride's.

leap-of-faith.label: Ride the Leap of Faith
leap-of-faith.desc: Climb the Tower of Neptune and drop near-vertically through a clear tube in the shark lagoon.
leap-of-faith.fact: A near-vertical plunge through a shark-filled lagoon at Aquaventure.

poseidons-revenge.label: Ride Poseidon's Revenge
poseidons-revenge.desc: Stand in the clear launch capsule, hear the countdown… then the floor drops away.
poseidons-revenge.fact: Riders stand in a capsule until a trapdoor opens beneath them.

aquaconda.label: Raft down the Aquaconda
aquaconda.desc: Pile into the big raft with other guests and spin down the giant tube together.
aquaconda.fact: A giant raft slide that carries up to six riders at a time.

aquaventure-river.label: Float the lazy river
aquaventure-river.desc: Sit back in a ring and drift around the island of palms. Pure chill.
aquaventure-river.fact: Aquaventure's river runs for over 2 km of rapids and calm water.

aquaventure-waves.label: Jump the waves
aquaventure-waves.desc: Wade into the wave pool and jump each wave as it rolls in.

jumeirah-sceirah.label: Race the Jumeirah Sceirah
jumeirah-sceirah.desc: Twin free-fall slides side by side: push off fast and beat the guest in the other lane.
jumeirah-sceirah.fact: Dubai's tallest free-fall slide: about 32 m up and close to 80 km/h.

tantrum-alley.label: Ride Tantrum Alley
tantrum-alley.desc: Spin through the tornado basins on a ring tube.
tantrum-alley.fact: Riders on rings whirl through three tornado-like funnels.

burj-surj.label: Ride Burj Surj
burj-surj.desc: A family ring ride that swirls round a giant bowl before the splash.

juhas-journey.label: Float Juha's Journey
juhas-journey.desc: Wild Wadi's lazy river: sit in a ring and drift around the park.
juhas-journey.fact: About 360 m of gentle river looping the park.

breakers-bay.label: Jump the waves in Breakers Bay
breakers-bay.desc: The region's biggest wave pool: time your jumps as the waves roll in.

wipeout-flowrider.label: Surf the Wipeout FlowRider
wipeout-flowrider.desc: Ride the surf machine: keep your balance, land tricks, try not to wipe out.
wipeout-flowrider.fact: A surf simulator pumping tonnes of water a second over a foam slope.

pool-swim.label: Swim laps
pool-swim.desc: Jump in and swim a lap there and back. Tap in rhythm to stroke faster.

pool-cannonball.label: Do a cannonball
pool-cannonball.desc: Run, jump, tuck at the top and make the biggest splash you can.

pool-float.label: Float on an inflatable
pool-float.desc: Lie back on a flamingo float and drift around the pool.

sea-swim.label: Swim out to the buoys
sea-swim.desc: Wade into the Arabian Gulf and swim out to the buoy line and back. Tap in rhythm to stroke.
sea-swim.fact: The Gulf is warm all year: around 23 °C in winter and over 32 °C in summer.

sunbathe.label: Sunbathe on a lounger
sunbathe.desc: Shades on, lie back and work on your tan. Turn over halfway, or you'll burn!

jet-ski.label: Ride a jet ski
jet-ski.desc: Hire a jet ski and race the buoy slalom out at sea. Steer through every gate.
jet-ski.fact: Jet skis must stay in marked zones off Dubai's beaches, away from swimmers.

paddleboard.label: Stand-up paddleboard
paddleboard.desc: Stand up, tap to paddle and keep your balance round the three buoys.

kitesurf.label: Kitesurf lesson
kitesurf.desc: Ride under the kite, time your pops for big jumps and tap again in the air to spin.
kitesurf.fact: Kite Beach gets steady afternoon sea breezes, which is how it got its name.

beach-volleyball.label: Play beach volleyball
beach-volleyball.desc: A rally match against a guest: first to 5. Tap just as the ball reaches you; perfect timing spikes it.

sandcastle.label: Build a sandcastle
sandcastle.desc: Pat the sand in a steady rhythm to build walls, towers, a moat and a flag. It stays on the beach while you're here.

skate.label: Public skating session
skate.desc: Skate laps of the rink: tap in rhythm to push, hold Lean through the corners. Too fast into a bend and down you go. Evenings are disco nights.
skate.fact: Dubai Ice Rink is Olympic-size, right inside The Dubai Mall.

skate-penguin.label: Skate with a penguin aid
skate-penguin.desc: New to the ice? Push a penguin skating aid round the rink: slower, but you won't fall.
skate-penguin.fact: The rink hires out penguin, seal and snowman skating aids for beginners.

skate-spin.label: Figure spin challenge
skate-spin.desc: Glide to the centre, hold to wind up a spin and let go before you get dizzy. Three tries: best spin counts.

bowling.label: Bowl three frames
bowling.desc: Pick your line, then your power: strikes and spares count double. Shoes included.

karaoke.label: Sing karaoke
karaoke.desc: Take the mic on stage and hit every beat: keep a streak and the crowd goes wild.

dance-off.label: Dance-off
dance-off.desc: Face off on the dance floor: hit each move (← ↑ → ↓) on the beat. The crowd picks the winner.

dj-set.label: Play a set on the decks
dj-set.desc: Take over the decks: build the track up and drop it right at the peak. Nail the drops and the floor goes wild.

full-meal.label: Have a sit-down meal
full-meal.desc: The host shows you to a table, you order from the menu and the waiter brings it over. Snap a food photo, then ask for the bill.

chef-show.label: Watch the chef's grill show
chef-show.desc: Take a seat at the grill: flames, flips and a shrimp tossed your way. Catch it!

spa-massage.label: 60-minute massage
spa-massage.desc: Lie face down while the therapist works out the knots. Breathe with the circle: hold as it grows, let go as it shrinks.

spa-hammam.label: Hammam scrub
spa-hammam.desc: The traditional steam-and-scrub ritual on a warm slab. Keep breathing slow and steady.
spa-hammam.fact: The hammam is a centuries-old bathing ritual across the Arab world: steam, black soap and a kessa-glove scrub.

spa-sauna.label: Sit in the sauna
spa-sauna.desc: The heat builds… leave when it's just right (the green zone). Stay too long and you'll overheat!

spa-plunge.label: Cold plunge
spa-plunge.desc: Jump into the icy plunge pool and tap to keep breathing for 10 seconds. Brrr!
spa-plunge.fact: Swapping a hot sauna for a cold plunge is a classic contrast-therapy ritual.

spa-jacuzzi.label: Soak in the jacuzzi
spa-jacuzzi.desc: Sink into the bubbles and let the warm water do the work. Get out whenever you like.

spa-facemask.label: Face mask & cucumbers
spa-facemask.desc: Lie back on a lounger with a cooling mask and cucumber slices on your eyes. Take a selfie for your story!

at-the-top.label: Ride up & spot the landmarks
at-the-top.desc: Shoot up the world's fastest lifts, then find Dubai's landmarks through the telescope.
at-the-top.fact: At the Top's lifts climb at about 10 m a second; the observation decks are on levels 124, 125 and 148.

sky-views.label: Ride up & spot the landmarks
sky-views.desc: Up to the 52nd floor of Address Sky View, then spot the sights from the glass deck.

view-palm.label: Ride up & spot the landmarks
view-palm.desc: Up to level 52 of The Palm Tower: the whole Palm Jumeirah laid out below.
view-palm.fact: The View at The Palm is 240 m up, with the Palm's fronds and crescent spread out below.

ain-dubai.label: Ride a cabin & spot the landmarks
ain-dubai.desc: Climb aboard a cabin of the world's biggest observation wheel and spot the sights from the top.
ain-dubai.fact: Ain Dubai is about 250 m tall, and one full turn takes around 38 minutes.

frame-bridge.label: Walk the glass bridge
frame-bridge.desc: Ride up 150 m and walk the glass floor between the towers. When the glass 'cracks' under you, freeze!
frame-bridge.fact: The Dubai Frame's glass bridge goes cloudy and plays a cracking effect as you walk across.

aquarium-shark.label: Walk the shark tunnel
aquarium-shark.desc: Walk through the acrylic tunnel and snap the sand tiger shark as it glides overhead.
aquarium-shark.fact: Dubai Aquarium's tank holds around 10 million litres of water and hundreds of sharks and rays.

lost-chambers-manta.label: Walk the ruins tunnel
lost-chambers-manta.desc: Through the Lost Chambers' underwater ruins: snap the giant manta as it flies past.
lost-chambers-manta.fact: The Lost Chambers is home to around 65,000 marine animals.

wax-selfies.label: Selfies with the wax figures
wax-selfies.desc: Strike the same pose as each wax figure before the flash goes off. (Our figures are generic lookalikes, not real people.)

vr-burj-drop.label: VR tower freefall
vr-burj-drop.desc: Headset on: step off the top of a supertall tower and hold Brake at the last moment to land softly.

style-challenge.label: Style challenge
style-challenge.desc: The stylist names an occasion: pick the right outfit, change in the fitting room and walk it to the mirror. Three looks.

trolley-dash.label: Trolley dash
trolley-dash.desc: Memorise the shopping list and its aisles, then push your trolley to each one from memory, and scan it all at self-checkout.

perfume-test.label: Find your scent
perfume-test.desc: Spray three testers and name each scent family from its description: oud, rose, citrus or jasmine.
perfume-test.fact: Oud, from agarwood, is the signature note of Arabian perfumery.

jewel-guess.label: Try it on & guess the price
jewel-guess.desc: The jeweller lets you try three pieces in the mirror. Guess what each one costs!

tech-demo.label: Reaction test at the demo
tech-demo.desc: Grab the controller at the demo station: tap the instant the screen turns green. Five rounds, average reaction time.
